claim: § Common Misunderstandings: 'EQ boosts existing frequencies. Saturation CREATES new harmonics.' § The Technical Side: even-order = warmth, odd-order = edge.

pieces.what: A sine through a drive knob with a live spectrum: harmonics appear; an EQ boost on the same sine adds nothing — the 'creates vs amplifies' test
A symmetry knob on the transfer curve: symmetric clipping gives only odd harmonics, asymmetric adds the even — shows the warmth claim depends on asymmetry the text takes for granted
Clean / light / medium / heavy on one vocal in a mix
